faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Before you start, here are the answers to the questions I get the most.

what_is.a: A wellbeing tool designed to help your body settle when your nervous system is on alert. Not a therapy, not a diagnosis — just simple, short actions you can do on your own, at your own pace.

price.a: You can freely try the emotion screens and the basic ritual without an account. Full access is €39 — a one-time payment, no subscription.

subscription.a: No. One-time €39 payment, lifetime access to the paid features available at the time of purchase.

medical.q: Does it replace medical care or a therapist?
medical.a: No, never. Ancrage is a wellbeing tool: it doesn't diagnose and doesn't replace a healthcare professional.

privacy.a: Yes. Your notes and emotional states are securely stored and remain strictly yours. You can export or delete everything from your profile.

duration.q: How much time does it take per day?
duration.a: A few minutes is enough. Most actions take between 1 and 5 minutes.

devices.q: Which devices does it work on?
devices.a: Any recent phone, tablet or computer, straight from your browser. No installation.

refund.a: Because digital access is immediate, you waive your withdrawal right at checkout. See the Terms for details.
